summary: This bill directs the Secretary of the Interior to establish a grant program to help low-income individuals and certain property owners make their homes and properties more resilient to climate change impacts, and requires the Director of the National Institute of Standards and Technology to develop resilience and adaptation standards.

scores.thoughts: The bill's primary purpose is to establish a grant program to help low-income individuals make their homes more resilient to the impacts of climate change, explicitly mentioning extreme weather events, flooding, wildfires, and heat. This directly addresses adaptation to environmental changes and protection against climate-driven hazards.
